documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a revenue of ₹ 472.2 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 53.3% year-on-year increase. EBITDA for the quarter stood at ₹ 92.3 crores with a margin of 19.2%, while profit after tax reached ₹ 65.6 crores with a margin of 13.6%. Management highlighted an ongoing capacity expansion from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA with a capex of approximately ₹ 200 crores funded through internal accruals, targeting commissioning by September 2026. The company also maintains a debt-free balance sheet with a gross debt to equity ratio of 0.0x. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY26, noting a revenue decrease of -8.7% to INR 1,276.0 crores alongside a PAT growth of 0.1% to INR 180.2 crores.

guidance.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: Electric Vehicle adoption accelerates consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward specialty and colored grades away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables and automotive will drive domestic demand for ABS.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted strong domestic growth opportunities due to a supply-demand gap where Indian ABS consumption significantly exceeds domestic manufacturing capacity.
demand_outlook.quote: There is immense scope for growth, considering the existing supply and demand mismatch, and knowing the fact that the consumption of ABS in India is voluminously larger as compared to the combined output of the domestic manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: A normal-to-above-normal monsoon forecast for 2026 is expected to reduce El Niño risks and support rural demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The IMD's June forecast indicates a normal-to-above-normal monsoon for 2026, reducing El Niño risk — a meaningful positive for rural demand and food inflation.

capex_expansion.claim: Orders have been placed for critical long-delivery equipment for expanding ABS capacity from 75,000 TPA to 100,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: Engineering, procurement, and construction work is ongoing to commission the enhanced 100,000 TPA capacity by end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores with margins at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: • EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores with margins at 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margin for FY 2025-26 increased to 19.42% from 17.43% in FY 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

margins_costs.claim: The company is implementing energy-saving measures using efficient equipment and alternative energy sources.
margins_costs.quote: Further, the Company is taking various steps for energy saving by way of efficient equipment and alternative sources of energy.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601 TPA against its installed capacity of 75,000 TPA during FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved production volume of 71601 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for FY 2025-26 stood at 71,501 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume stood at 71501 TPA (Previous year - 74381 TPA).

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a zero gross debt to equity ratio.
The Board declared three interim dividends of Re. 1 each and recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per equity share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Continuing with the practice of rewarding shareholders, the Board declared three Interim Dividends, each of Re.1/- (collectively 300%) per Equity shares of Re.1/- and recommended a Final Dividend of Re.1/- (100 %) per Equity Share for the Financial Year Ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained its status as a zero-debt company.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The company will sustain its business operations entirely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: There was no change in financing pattern and the Company would be able to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The business faces foreign exchange risks as core raw materials Styrene and Acrylonitrile are entirely dependent on imports.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sharp drops in international monomer prices driven by oil, benzene, or ethylene volatility pose severe inventory loss risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: The limitation arises out of deliberate decision on the part of domestic manufacturers to keep low inventories of its imported key raw materials which is more than 85% (i.e. Styrene and Acrylonitrile monomers) to limit the risk of price fluctuations which may result in huge loss, if the price of monomers drastically falls in the international market, which happen many a times due to unpredictable reasons, i.e. fluctuation in price of crude oil, benzene and ethylene.

management_commitments.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the enhanced ABS capacity to 100,000 TPA is expected to be completed by end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
